{{Quote|Please. My name is Thranc Roulus. I have a family in Kaas City. Give us the order to evacuate...|Thranc Roulus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Thranc Roulus''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] stationed in the [[Kwenn system/Legends|Kwenn system]] during [[Eradication Day]]. During the attack by the [[Eradicator (weapon)|Eradicator weapons]] the personnel tried to abandon the burning station, but [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Phaaral]] threatened to kill any deserters attempting to flee. In an attempt to save his life Thranc, who had a family in [[Kaas City]], contacted Imperial forces through remote transmission, trying to get a valid order to evacuate from somebody else.
